hints.title: Two-Sided Matching
hints.text: Initialize boundary indices at the leftmost and rightmost elements of the array.

hints.title: Greedy Merge Decision
hints.text: If the left and right values are equal, advance both pointers inward. If unequal, greedily merge the smaller endpoint with its adjacent neighbor.

hints.title: Operation Accumulation
hints.text: Each merge increments the operation counter by 1 until the two pointers cross.

hints.title: Two-Pointer Palindromic Merge Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def minimumOperations(self, nums: list[int]) -> int:
        left = 0
        right = len(nums) - 1
        l_val = nums[left]
        r_val = nums[right]
        ops = 0
        
        while left < right:
            if l_val == r_val:
                left += 1
                right -= 1
                l_val = nums[left]
                r_val = nums[right]
            elif l_val < r_val:
                left += 1
                l_val += nums[left]
                ops += 1
            else:
                right -= 1
                r_val += nums[right]
                ops += 1
        return ops
```

complexity.notes: Two pointers scan inward in a single pass.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recursive exploration of merge choices explores exponential branches.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(1) memory by maintaining running endpoint sums.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Uses greedy opposite two-pointer technique to equalize endpoint prefix and suffix sums.
